scientific_question: Under an identical recorded ARC-AGI-3 sensory trajectory, does fixed MaleCNS recurrent topology preserve or expose temporal information differently from matched topology controls?

reservoir.leak_only_definition: same per-unit leak and input projection, recurrent W=0
reservoir.stateless_definition: instantaneous tanh input response with no recurrent or leak memory

memory_probe.target: fixed random signed sketch of categorical ARC frame features
memory_probe.state_standardization: train-fold featurewise z-score followed by division by sqrt(state_dim)
memory_probe.primary_metric: mean over frozen lags of reservoir_R2 minus current_frame_input_R2
memory_probe.purpose_of_current_frame_baseline: control for slow screen dynamics that make past frames predictable from the present without memory
memory_probe.cross_validation: leave-one-reset-segment-out when >=2 usable segments; otherwise blocked folds with temporal purge

secondary_metrics: next-frame sketch R2 and excess over current-frame baseline
approximate participation-ratio effective dimension on deterministic 256-neuron body-ID hash subsample
rank needed for 95% variance on the same deterministic subsample

marathon_defaults.scheduling: all anchor controls across projection blocks first, then topology nulls round-robin across blocks
marathon_defaults.resume_policy: atomic per-job JSON; exact manifest required; completed jobs skipped

claim_boundaries: This is a developmental representation study, not evidence that a fruit fly understands ARC.
The ARC-to-neuron input projection is engineered and not a natural sensory mapping.
Modeled reservoir states are not neural recordings.
A positive intact-versus-null descriptive separation on LS20 is hypothesis-generating only.
No leak, gain, reservoir size, projection schedule, target sketch, lag set, ridge strength, or primary metric may be changed because it improves the intact result.
Any confirmatory topology claim requires a new frozen multi-game evaluation manifest and held-out trajectories.
next_confirmatory_gate: Freeze multiple ARC games and topology-independent trajectories before testing a predeclared effect on held-out games.
